Fact.Name: Idaho income tax threshold, single
Fact.Description: Form 40 line 20 worksheet, line 2, for a single filer. Idaho Code § 63-3024(2)(a): "The tax imposed upon individuals, trusts, and estates shall be computed at the rate of five and three-tenths percent (5.3%) of taxable income over two thousand five hundred dollars ($2,500)." Subsection (3) indexes that threshold. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 20 worksheet: "Single or married filing separately, enter $4,811." Married filing separately is not in scope. These are the 2025 indexed figures. Swap this amount for the 2026 schedule when the Commission posts it.

Fact.Name: Idaho income tax threshold, married filing jointly
Fact.Description: Form 40 line 20 worksheet, line 2, for a joint return. Idaho Code § 63-3024(2)(b): "For taxpayers filing a joint return pursuant to the provisions of section 63-3031, Idaho Code, the tax imposed shall be computed at the rate of five and three-tenths percent (5.3%) of taxable income over five thousand dollars ($5,000)." Subsection (3) indexes that threshold. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 20 worksheet: "Married filing jointly, head of household, or qualifying surviving spouse, enter $9,622." Head of household and qualifying surviving spouse are not in scope. These are the 2025 indexed figures. Swap this amount for the 2026 schedule when the Commission posts it.

Fact.Name: Idaho individual income tax rate
Fact.Description: Form 40 line 20 worksheet, line 4. Idaho Code § 63-3024(2)(a): "computed at the rate of five and three-tenths percent (5.3%)." The same sentence is in subsection (2)(b) for a joint return. The codified text was amended in 2025 (2025, ch. 13, sec. 3). 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 20 worksheet: "Multiply subtotal by 5.3%." Stored as 53/1000. The amount is rounded once, half up, to the dollar.

Fact.Name: Idaho Permanent Building Fund tax
Fact.Description: Form 40 line 31. Idaho Code § 63-3082(1): "Every person required to file an income tax return shall pay a tax of ten dollars ($10.00). For this purpose, a husband and wife filing a joint return shall be deemed a single person." One $10 amount per return, including a joint return. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 31: "You must pay the $10 PBF tax if Idaho requires you to file an Idaho income tax return." Receiving Idaho public assistance at year end waives it. That case stops, so a supported return always enters $10.

Fact.Name: Idaho Food Tax Credit for one filer
Fact.Description: Form 40 line 43, one filer for the full year. Idaho Code § 63-3024A(1): "For tax year 2025 and each year thereafter, the credit is one hundred fifty-five dollars ($155)." 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 43: "The credit is either $155 each for you, your spouse, and your qualifying dependents." Dependents are not in scope. A filer who received SNAP or was incarcerated stops, so the partial-month proration is not calculated. A supported single return claims $155. A supported joint return claims $155 for each spouse.

Fact.Name: Idaho residency answers
Fact.Description: Full-year resident is the supported Form 40. Part-year residents and nonresidents use Form 43. A joint return is a full-year Form 40 only when both spouses lived in Idaho all year.

Fact.Name: Idaho residency
Fact.Description: Full year means you, and your spouse if you file jointly, lived in Idaho all year. Part-year and nonresident stop. Form 40 and Form 43.

Fact.Name: Idaho residency is part-year or nonresident
Fact.Description: True for Form 43. Incomplete until /idResidencyStatus is answered.

Fact.Name: Idaho use tax owed
Fact.Description: Form 40 line 28, sales or use tax due on untaxed purchases. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 28: "You owe use tax if you did either of these during the year: Bought items without paying Idaho sales tax." Yes stops the return. The 6 percent worksheet is not calculated. Incomplete until answered.

Fact.Name: Idaho public assistance at year end
Fact.Description: Form 40 line 31 checkbox. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 31: "You were receiving Idaho public assistance payments at the end of the tax year. Check the box on this line and draw a line through the $10. Food stamps and WIC payments don't qualify as Idaho public assistance." Yes waives the Permanent Building Fund tax. That waiver is not calculated. Yes stops the return. Incomplete until answered.

Fact.Name: Filer received SNAP or was incarcerated
Fact.Description: Asked once for the filer: "Did you receive federal food stamp (SNAP) benefits or were you incarcerated during any part of the year?" Idaho Code § 63-3024A(5) prorates the credit for any month or part of a month of federal food stamp assistance. Subsection (6) prorates it for incarceration. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 43: an individual can't qualify for a month in which the person "Received assistance from the federal food stamp program" or "Was incarcerated." Yes stops the return. Partial-month proration is not modeled. Incomplete until answered.

Fact.Name: Spouse received SNAP or was incarcerated
Fact.Description: The same SNAP or incarceration question for the spouse on a joint return. Asked only on a joint return. Yes stops the return. Idaho Code § 63-3024A(5) and (6).

Fact.Name: Ask the spouse Idaho questions
Fact.Description: True on a joint Idaho return, so the spouse SNAP question is asked. False for a single filer and when this is not an Idaho return.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 7 federal adjusted gross income
Fact.Description: Federal AGI. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 7: "Enter your federal adjusted gross income from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11."

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 8 additions
Fact.Description: Zero. Form 39R additions are not in scope. W-2 wages only do not reach them.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 9 total
Fact.Description: Add lines 7 and 8. Line 8 is zero, so this equals line 7.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 10 subtractions
Fact.Description: Zero. Form 39R subtractions are not in scope. W-2 wages only do not reach them.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 11 total adjusted income
Fact.Description: Subtract line 10 from line 9. Line 10 is zero, so this equals line 7.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 13 itemized deductions
Fact.Description: Zero. Federal Schedule A is not used. Itemized deductions stop the return.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 14 state and local tax add-back
Fact.Description: Zero. Idaho Code § 63-3022(a) adds state and local taxes measured by net income, and § 63-3022(j)(2) keeps itemized deductions "except state or local taxes measured by net income and general sales taxes." That line 14 add-back is not calculated. Itemized deductions stop the return.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 15 Idaho itemized deductions
Fact.Description: Zero. 2025 Form 40, line 15: subtract line 14 from line 13, and enter zero when federal Schedule A is not used. Schedule A is not used.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 16 standard deduction
Fact.Description: The federal standard deduction for the filing status, which is Form 1040 line 12 when the standard deduction applies. Idaho Code § 63-3022(j)(1): "The standard deduction as defined in section 63 of the Internal Revenue Code." Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §4.14 sets that 2026 amount at $16,100 for a single filer and $32,200 for a joint return. The 2025 form's margin figures ($15,750 and $31,500) are the 2025 federal amounts. This fact reads the federal standard deduction. It does not hardcode those margin figures. Itemized deductions, age 65, blindness, and being claimed as a dependent stop the return.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 17
Fact.Description: Subtract the larger of line 15 or 16 from line 11. Line 15 is zero, so this is line 11 minus line 16, not below zero. 2025 Form 40, line 17.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 18 qualified business income and Schedule 1-A
Fact.Description: 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 18: "Add lines 13a and 13b from federal Form 1040 or 1040-SR and enter the total on this line." On the 2026 draft Form 1040 this tool fills, line 13a is Schedule 1-A line 44 and line 13b is the qualified business income deduction. The sum is floored at zero. In scope it is zero: qualified business income is zero for W-2 wages only, and Schedule 1-A greater than zero stops the return. The READY spec labels Schedule 1-A as line 13b. This draft prints it on line 13a. The stop follows the Schedule 1-A amount, not that label.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 19 Idaho taxable income
Fact.Description: Subtract line 18 from line 17, not below zero. 2025 Form 40, line 19. Idaho Code § 63-3022 applies the additions and subtractions, which are zero in scope, and the standard deduction.

Fact.Name: Idaho line 20 worksheet threshold
Fact.Description: $4,811 for single. $9,622 for married filing jointly. Other filing statuses use the single figure and stop. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 20 worksheet, line 2.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 20 worksheet line 3
Fact.Description: Line 19 minus the filing-status threshold, not below zero. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 20 worksheet: "Subtract line 2 from line 1. Enter the subtotal." "If zero or less, enter zero" on worksheet line 5.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 20 after the cent-then-dollar round
Fact.Description: Round(worksheet line 3 times 5.3%). Dollar times Rational scales to cents half-even before Round half-up, so a product whose exact fraction is just under half a dollar can become 50 cents and then round up a dollar. 38,783 times 0.053 is 2,055.499, which that path turns into 2,056. This is not the amount entered on the form.

Fact.Name: One hundred times the exact Form 40 line 20
Fact.Description: Worksheet line 3 times 53/10. That is 100 times line 3 times 0.053, and for a whole-dollar line 3 it keeps the exact tenth of a cent. 38,783 times 53/10 is 205,549.9 cents, which is 2,055.499 dollars. 38,500 times 53/10 is 204,050 cents, which is 2,040.50 dollars.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 20 tax
Fact.Description: Worksheet line 3 times 5.3 percent, rounded once, half up, to the dollar. The cent-then-dollar result is one dollar high when it exceeds this exact product by more than 50 cents. An exact half dollar, 2,040.50, stays 2,041. 38,783 times 0.053 is 2,055.499 and stays 2,055. 2025 Form 40 instructions, Rounding: "Round the amounts on your return to the nearest whole dollar. Round down if under 50 cents, round up if 50 cents or more." Line 20 worksheet: "Multiply subtotal by 5.3%." Idaho Code § 63-3024(2).

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 26 tax after credits
Fact.Description: Subtract line 25 from line 20. Lines 21 through 25 are zero in scope, so this equals line 20. The credit for tax paid to other states, charitable credits, business credits, and the Idaho child tax credit are not calculated.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 31 Permanent Building Fund tax
Fact.Description: $10 per return. Idaho Code § 63-3082(1). A joint return pays one $10 tax. Public assistance that would waive it stops the return.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 32 total tax
Fact.Description: Add lines 26 through 31. Lines 27 through 30 are zero, so this is line 20 plus the $10 Permanent Building Fund tax. Use tax on line 28 stops the return.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 41 total tax plus donations
Fact.Description: Add lines 32 through 40. Donations on lines 33 through 40 are not offered, so this equals line 32.

Fact.Name: Food Tax Credit for the spouse
Fact.Description: $155 on a joint return and zero otherwise. Idaho Code § 63-3024A(1). The spouse SNAP question stops a joint return that cannot claim the full-year amount.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 43 Food Tax Credit
Fact.Description: $155 for the filer, plus $155 for the spouse on a joint return. Idaho Code § 63-3024A(1). Dependents are not in scope. Donation of the credit is not offered.

Fact.Name: This W-2's Idaho withholding
Fact.Description: Box 17 when box 15 is Idaho (the same state as the residence). A blank box 15 is in scope and contributes zero. A box 15 for another state stops the return and contributes zero here.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 46 Idaho income tax withheld
Fact.Description: Sum of W-2 box 17 where box 15 is Idaho. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 46: "Enter the total amount of Idaho income tax withheld."

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 50 payments and other credits
Fact.Description: Add lines 42 through 49. Lines 42, 44, 45, and 47 through 49 are zero. This is the Food Tax Credit plus Idaho withholding.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 51 tax due
Fact.Description: If line 41 is more than line 50, subtract line 50 from line 41. Otherwise zero. 2025 Form 40, line 51.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 54 total due
Fact.Description: Add lines 51 and 52, then subtract line 53. Lines 52 and 53 are zero, so this equals line 51.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 55 overpaid
Fact.Description: If line 41 is less than line 50, subtract lines 41 and 52 from line 50. Line 52 is zero. Otherwise zero. 2025 Form 40, line 55.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 56 refund
Fact.Description: The refunded amount. Nothing on line 55 is applied to next year's estimated tax, so this equals line 55. 2025 Form 40, line 56.

Fact.Name: Form 40 zero
Fact.Description: Printed on lines this return does not calculate: credits, use tax, donations, fuels, estimates, and the penalty lines. Those cases stop or are not offered.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 6a yourself
Fact.Description: Enter 1 unless someone else claims you as a dependent. Being claimed stops the return, so a supported return enters 1. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 6a.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 6b spouse
Fact.Description: Enter 1 on a joint return. Otherwise zero. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 6b.

Fact.Name: Form 40 line 6d total household
Fact.Description: Add lines 6a through 6c. Dependents on line 6c are zero because a dependent stops the return. This is 1 for single and 2 for a joint return.

Fact.Name: Federal income other than W-2 wages
Fact.Description: Interest, tax-exempt interest, Social Security, a sale or capital gain, 1099-MISC, a 1099-R, Schedule C, or Schedule E. Any of that income stops a Form 40.

Fact.Name: Dependents or a qualifying person
Fact.Description: Anyone in the household, or a filer who is a qualifying person for the child and dependent care credit. The Idaho child tax credit on line 24 and the dependent Food Tax Credit are not calculated.

Fact.Name: Age 65 or blind
Fact.Description: Primary filer is 65 or older or blind. On a joint return, either spouse. Form 40 lines 12a and 12b are not calculated. The additional standard deduction is not entered. The spouse is checked only on a joint return so a single return does not wait on the spouse.

Fact.Name: Filer can be claimed as a dependent
Fact.Description: Form 40 line 12c. The primary filer, or either spouse on a joint return. The dependent standard-deduction worksheet is not applied. 2025 Form 40 instructions, line 12c.

Fact.Name: Filing status other than single or joint
Fact.Description: The supported Form 40 is single, or married filing jointly with both spouses in Idaho all year. Head of household, married filing separately, and qualifying surviving spouse are not calculated.

Fact.Name: Federal Schedule 1-A is more than zero
Fact.Description: Qualified tips, overtime, car-loan interest, or the senior deduction on Schedule 1-A line 44. The 2026 draft Form 1040 prints that amount on line 13a. The READY spec calls the Schedule 1-A stop line 13b. Idaho's 2026 IRC conformity date is not pinned, so the deduction is not entered on line 18. Incomplete when line 44 is incomplete.

Fact.Name: A filer received SNAP or was incarcerated
Fact.Description: The filer answered yes, or the spouse answered yes on a joint return. Idaho Code § 63-3024A(5) and (6).

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Idaho part-year or nonresident
Fact.Description: Form 43 is not calculated. Complete false when this is not an Idaho return. Incomplete until /idResidencyStatus is answered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: a W-2 box 15 is not Idaho
Fact.Description: Any W-2 whose box 15 is a state other than Idaho. A blank box 15 is in scope and is not this stop. Complete false when this is not an Idaho return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: income other than W-2 wages
Fact.Description: Any federal income other than W-2 wages. Complete false when this is not an Idaho return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: dependents
Fact.Description: The Idaho child tax credit and the dependent Food Tax Credit are not calculated. Complete false when this is not an Idaho return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: age 65 or blind
Fact.Description: Lines 12a and 12b are not calculated. Complete false when this is not an Idaho return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: claimed as a dependent
Fact.Description: Line 12c is not calculated. Complete false when this is not an Idaho return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: filing status other than single or joint
Fact.Description: Head of household, married filing separately, and qualifying surviving spouse are outside this Form 40. Complete false when this is not an Idaho return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: itemized deductions
Fact.Description: Idaho requires the line 14 state-and-local-tax add-back when the filer itemizes. That add-back is not calculated. Idaho Code § 63-3022(a) and (j)(2). Complete false when this is not an Idaho return. Incomplete until the itemizing choice is answered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: federal Schedule 1-A deduction
Fact.Description: Schedule 1-A line 44 is greater than zero, including qualified overtime. Idaho's 2026 IRC conformity date is not pinned, so the deduction is not flowed to line 18. The 2026 draft Form 1040 prints Schedule 1-A on line 13a. The READY spec names that stop as line 13b. Complete false when this is not an Idaho return and when line 44 is zero.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Idaho public assistance
Fact.Description: Idaho public assistance at the end of the year waives the line 31 Permanent Building Fund tax. That waiver is not calculated. Complete false when this is not an Idaho return. Incomplete until the question is answered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Idaho use tax
Fact.Description: Line 28 use tax is not calculated. Complete false when this is not an Idaho return. Incomplete until the question is answered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: SNAP benefits or incarceration
Fact.Description: A yes on the SNAP or incarceration question. The Food Tax Credit is not prorated for a partial month. Idaho Code § 63-3024A(5) and (6). Complete false when this is not an Idaho return. Incomplete until the question is answered. On a joint return, incomplete until the spouse answers.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Form 39R additions or subtractions
Fact.Description: Idaho 529 and the Idaho HSA subtraction are Form 39R additions or subtractions. They are not reachable with W-2 wages only, so this stop is complete false. No Idaho 529 or HSA question is asked, and those amounts are not collected on this return. Idaho Code § 63-3022 is the list of additions and subtractions applied in computing Idaho taxable income.
